parts.text:
To Orc: Sol proposal for standard#6 (distributable kit and contribution path), documentation only, on branch sol/6-distributable-kit from dev 6dc2a7a. Content commit bcf0a00df12ed1289159c01626ab435294827d82: new docs/KIT_PROPOSAL.md and one README index row.

Content: journey and minimal layout (required: README, AGENTS, rules pages, config defaults/schema/example, demo with menu, checks, licences; recommended: manifest, generated single-file HTML; optional: Docker, Figma); one source for presentation, demo and Figma; usage paths (offline single file, screenshots instead of a hosted preview until H6, Docker with WSL not yet verified on Windows, external code as already proven, Figma .fig only from Figma itself with plugin-generated variables, plan-dependent modes, spike first); four-step new-system path separating fork/PR, proposal and maintainer rights; checklist split into automated checks, Des review and maintainers' decisions, never judging consumer values; template folder and standard declared by commit SHA. Console gaps: rules pages, demo menu, single-file HTML, README screenshots/status, optional manifest, Docker, Figma.

Arbitrations K1-K7 for midas; six questions for Des (not started). Checks: local links resolve; git diff --check clean. No change to Console, frontend, repositories or permissions.

To Revex (copy Orc): Sol revised standard#7 after midas's arbitration and Orc's framing (issue 6 comment 6930098554), same branch from 0237f34, no rebase. Content commit d42bf6ef5a878d111bd1ae966124395dae2cbf5b.

Changes in docs/KIT_PROPOSAL.md: one self-contained HTML per system (presentation page, examples by menu, configuration kept in memory and URL hash) as accepted; Docker, HTML and .fig companion kept as required target deliverables, delivered progressively, with the Figma spike as a feasibility risk and midas deciding on failure; two-commit rule so the generated HTML is reviewable at the candidate HEAD and reproducible from its embedded source commit; unknown asset provenance resolved, replaced or excluded, never accepted by discretion; external catalogue listing separated as a later extension; work grouped in batches A-F with routing Revus for Devex, Revex for Des and Claude roles; executable Folio and Marquee scopes reusing Console by provenance copy, front e492bec read-only, icons excluded, independent of the Figma batch, with system-specific adaptations (Folio panel tokens and focus, neutral monogram slot instead of the W branding, Source Serif 4; Marquee link and focus defaults, hover lift, Manrope 800).

Checks: local links resolve; git diff --check clean. No extraction, publication or permission change.
